title: Record service event
purpose: Record maintenance, calibration, a repair, temperature mapping or a qualification performed on a piece of equipment, with its certificate or report.
summary: Record maintenance, calibration, a repair, temperature mapping or a qualification performed on equipment, with its certificate or report.

tasks.title: Record the event
steps: Choose the [[Kind]], the [[Performed on]] date and the [[Outcome]].
Name the staff member or outside provider, and attach the [[Certificate or report]].

tasks.title: Set the next due date
steps: Enter [[Next due]]. It appears under Maintenance due.

good_to_know: Next due is your repository's own date. It is never computed.
Files are checked by content, not only by name.
The kind cannot be changed by a correction.
Do not enter donor, patient or participant names in any field.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators. Viewers are refused. When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice that gives the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee. A retired piece of equipment takes no new events; a manager changes its status first.
Opened from the Record service event button on the equipment record, or from a row of Maintenance due, which preselects the kind.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Required. Preventive maintenance, Calibration, Repair or service call, Temperature mapping, Qualification or verification. The kind cannot be changed by a later correction.

items.label: Performed on
items.description: Required date, not in the future. Defaults to today.

items.label: Outcome
items.description: Required. Maintenance and repair: Completed or Not acceptable. Calibration, mapping and qualification: Acceptable or Not acceptable.

items.label: Performed by (staff)
items.description: A staff member with an account. Defaults to you.

items.label: Performed by (outside provider)
items.description: Free text up to 160 characters. Either a staff member or an outside provider must be named.

items.label: Reference
items.description: Optional, up to 160 characters: certificate, work order or procedure reference.

items.label: Description
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters: what was done; for a repair, the cause. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

items.label: Reference device
items.description: Optional, up to 160 characters. Calibration: the reference instrument's name and serial number.

items.label: As found, As left
items.description: Optional, up to 200 characters each: the instrument's condition or readings before and after.

items.label: Next due
items.description: Optional date, not before the date performed. Your repository's own date for the next event of this kind; it is never computed. It cannot be set on a repair. It feeds Maintenance due and the equipment record, and a later event of the same kind replaces it (an event without a date clears it).

items.label: Certificate or report
items.description: Optional file: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV, up to 10 MiB. The type is checked from the file's content, not only its name, and text files must be UTF-8. It is stored with the event and downloaded as a file, never displayed inside the page. If the repository has set a limit on the total size of attached files and it would be exceeded, the file is refused and nothing is recorded.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Record service event adds the event to the equipment's log and the audit trail together. It cannot be edited; to change it use Correct on the equipment record. Errors appear beside the field and what you typed is kept (a chosen file has to be chosen again).
